deliberate_timer_event_fixture_retention.policy: Source-only, reserved, holder-installed and cancellation-installed owners are abandoned under heap and actual timer queue holds. The source-only phase has independent list admission and no event reservation. Other phases retain their three original charges. All sources/callbacks persist; independent waiter cancellation releases only entries. No live sponsor replacement, counter reset, user root, real LP delivery claim, recovery or replay custody.

prior_completion_metadata_fixture_retent.policy: Existing bounded private raw-namespace negative controls now retain their complete global nodes too. Original account/list/buffer owners remain until guest shutdown; no actual user root, live sponsor replacement, counter reset or retry custody.

prior_timer_cancellation_fixture_retenti.policy: One bare cancellation handle and one complete successful cancellation result are abandoned under heap and real queue holds. Bare-handle abandonment does not set the flag; its event fires and leaves only original cancellation backing charged. The complete handback retains removed node/event/source/callback plus handle and original admission. Independent waiter cancellation releases only its entry. No live sponsor replacement, counter reset, user root, real LP delivery claim, recovery or replay custody.

prior_timer_delivery_fixture_retention_p.policy: A complete selected/purged owner is abandoned under held heap and real queue guards. Both original charges and source lists persist until shutdown. Only its private fixture claim remains fenced; no actual LP claim is abandoned. Independent waiter cancellation releases its own entries only. No live sponsor replacement, counter reset, user root, recovery or replay custody.

prior_timer_disposal_fixture_retention_p.policy: One private anonymous retirement receipt is abandoned with heap and queue held. Its original event/node/cancellation backing and empty source list remain retained until guest shutdown; independent token cancellation releases only its waiter entry. No live sponsor replacement, user root, counter reset or retry custody.

prior_timer_node_fixture_retention_per_g.policy: One pre-allocation preparation and one empty-backing preparation are abandoned under heap and actual timer queue holds. Each retains its complete original event/cancellation/source/callback/admission; the latter also retains one uninitialized Box. Independent waiter cancellation releases only its entry. No live sponsor replacement, counter reset, user root, real LP delivery claim, recovery or replay custody.

prior_timer_preparation_fixture_retentio.policy: One completed unpublished PreparedEvent is abandoned under held heap and real queue guards. Its original node/event/cancellation backing, callback and source list persist until shutdown. Independent waiter cancellation releases only its entry. No live sponsor replacement, counter reset, user root, real queue claim, recovery or replay custody.
